SELECT /* getReportList */ A.REPT_NUMB , A.USER_NUMB , A.BOOK_NUMB , A.REPT_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{codeReadStat}, A.REPT_STAT) AS REPT_STAT_NAME , A.REPT_STDT , A.REPT_ENDT , A.REPT_GRDE , A.REPT_COLR , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{codeBookColr}, A.REPT_COLR) AS REPT_COLR_NAME , A.PUBC_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{codeCommYsno}, A.PUBC_YSNO, #{optPubcYsno}) AS PUBC_YSNO_NAME , A.REPT_CNTN , B.BOOK_TITL , B.BOOK_CVIM , CASE WHEN A.REPT_STAT = #{reptStat} THEN #{commYes} ELSE #{commNo} END AS READING_YN FROM TM_REPORT A LEFT JOIN TM_BKINFO B ON A.BOOK_NUMB = B.BOOK_NUMB WHERE A.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb}
AND ( LOWER(B.BOOK_TITL) LIKE LOWER(#{bookKeywordLike}) OR LOWER(B.BOOK_ATHR) LIKE LOWER(#{bookKeywordLike}) )
ORDER BY A.REPT_STDT DESC, A.REPT_NUMB DESC
ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(A.REPT_GRDE) DESC, A.REPT_ENDT DESC, A.REPT_NUMB DESC
ORDER BY A.REPT_ENDT DESC, A.REPT_NUMB DESC

WITH REPORTBASE AS ( SELECT /*+ MATERIALIZE */ A.REPT_ENDT , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.REPT_ENDT, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'IYYYIW') AS WEEK_GOAL_DATE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.REPT_ENDT, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM') AS MONTH_GOAL_DATE , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.REPT_ENDT, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY') || '00' AS YEAR_GOAL_DATE FROM TM_REPORT A WHERE A.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND A.REPT_STAT = #{doneStat} AND A.REPT_ENDT IS NOT NULL ) , PERIODCNT AS ( SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.REPT_ENDT >= #{currentWeekStart} AND A.REPT_ENDT < #{nextWeekStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS CURRENT_WEEK_COUNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.REPT_ENDT >= #{previousWeekStart} AND A.REPT_ENDT < #{currentWeekStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS PREVIOUS_WEEK_COUNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.REPT_ENDT >= #{currentMonthStart} AND A.REPT_ENDT < #{nextMonthStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS CURRENT_MONTH_COUNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.REPT_ENDT >= #{previousMonthStart} AND A.REPT_ENDT < #{currentMonthStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS PREVIOUS_MONTH_COUNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.REPT_ENDT >= #{currentYearStart} AND A.REPT_ENDT < #{nextYearStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS CURRENT_YEAR_COUNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN A.REPT_ENDT >= #{previousYearStart} AND A.REPT_ENDT < #{currentYearStart} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS PREVIOUS_YEAR_COUNT FROM REPORTBASE A ) , REPORTGOAL AS ( SELECT A.GOAL_TYPE , A.GOAL_DATE , COUNT(*) AS DONE_CNT FROM ( SELECT #{weekGoalType} AS GOAL_TYPE , A.WEEK_GOAL_DATE AS GOAL_DATE FROM REPORTBASE A UNION ALL SELECT #{monthGoalType} AS GOAL_TYPE , A.MONTH_GOAL_DATE AS GOAL_DATE FROM REPORTBASE A UNION ALL SELECT #{yearGoalType} AS GOAL_TYPE , A.YEAR_GOAL_DATE AS GOAL_DATE FROM REPORTBASE A ) A GROUP BY A.GOAL_TYPE , A.GOAL_DATE ) , GOALSUMMARY AS ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN G.GOAL_TYPE = #{weekGoalType} AND G.GOAL_DATE = #{currentWeekGoalDate} THEN G.GOAL_CNTT END) AS WEEK_GOAL_CNT , MAX(CASE WHEN G.GOAL_TYPE = #{weekGoalType} AND G.GOAL_DATE = #{previousWeekGoalDate} THEN G.GOAL_CNTT END) AS PREVIOUS_WEEK_GOAL_CNT , MAX(CASE WHEN G.GOAL_TYPE = #{monthGoalType} AND G.GOAL_DATE = #{currentMonthGoalDate} THEN G.GOAL_CNTT END) AS MONTH_GOAL_CNT , MAX(CASE WHEN G.GOAL_TYPE = #{monthGoalType} AND G.GOAL_DATE = #{previousMonthGoalDate} THEN G.GOAL_CNTT END) AS PREVIOUS_MONTH_GOAL_CNT , MAX(CASE WHEN G.GOAL_TYPE = #{yearGoalType} AND G.GOAL_DATE = #{currentYearGoalDate} THEN G.GOAL_CNTT END) AS YEAR_GOAL_CNT , MAX(CASE WHEN G.GOAL_TYPE = #{yearGoalType} AND G.GOAL_DATE = #{previousYearGoalDate} THEN G.GOAL_CNTT END) AS PREVIOUS_YEAR_GOAL_CNT , MAX(CASE WHEN G.GOAL_TYPE = #{weekGoalType} AND G.GOAL_DATE = #{currentWeekGoalDate} THEN NVL(G.UPDT_CNTT, 0) END) AS WEEK_GOAL_UPDT_CNT , MAX(CASE WHEN G.GOAL_TYPE = #{monthGoalType} AND G.GOAL_DATE = #{currentMonthGoalDate} THEN NVL(G.UPDT_CNTT, 0) END) AS MONTH_GOAL_UPDT_CNT , MAX(CASE WHEN G.GOAL_TYPE = #{yearGoalType} AND G.GOAL_DATE = #{currentYearGoalDate} THEN NVL(G.UPDT_CNTT, 0) END) AS YEAR_GOAL_UPDT_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN G.GOAL_TYPE = #{weekGoalType} AND G.GOAL_CNTT > 0 AND NVL(R.DONE_CNT, 0) >= G.GOAL_CNTT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS WEEK_GOAL_ACHV_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN G.GOAL_TYPE = #{monthGoalType} AND G.GOAL_CNTT > 0 AND NVL(R.DONE_CNT, 0) >= G.GOAL_CNTT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS MONTH_GOAL_ACHV_CNT , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN G.GOAL_TYPE = #{yearGoalType} AND G.GOAL_CNTT > 0 AND NVL(R.DONE_CNT, 0) >= G.GOAL_CNTT THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS YEAR_GOAL_ACHV_CNT FROM TM_GOALXM G LEFT JOIN REPORTGOAL R ON G.GOAL_TYPE = R.GOAL_TYPE AND G.GOAL_DATE = R.GOAL_DATE WHERE G.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} ) SELECT /* getReadingSummary */ P.CURRENT_WEEK_COUNT , P.PREVIOUS_WEEK_COUNT , P.CURRENT_MONTH_COUNT , P.PREVIOUS_MONTH_COUNT , P.CURRENT_YEAR_COUNT , P.PREVIOUS_YEAR_COUNT , G.WEEK_GOAL_CNT , G.PREVIOUS_WEEK_GOAL_CNT , G.MONTH_GOAL_CNT , G.PREVIOUS_MONTH_GOAL_CNT , G.YEAR_GOAL_CNT , G.PREVIOUS_YEAR_GOAL_CNT , G.WEEK_GOAL_UPDT_CNT , G.MONTH_GOAL_UPDT_CNT , G.YEAR_GOAL_UPDT_CNT , G.WEEK_GOAL_ACHV_CNT , G.MONTH_GOAL_ACHV_CNT , G.YEAR_GOAL_ACHV_CNT FROM PERIODCNT P CROSS JOIN GOALSUMMARY G

SELECT /* getReadingSummaryReportList */ A.REPT_NUMB , A.USER_NUMB , A.BOOK_NUMB , A.REPT_STAT , A.REPT_STDT , A.REPT_ENDT , A.REPT_GRDE , A.PUBC_YSNO , REGEXP_REPLACE(B.BOOK_TITL, '[[:space:]]*\([^)]*\)[[:space:]]*$', '') AS BOOK_TITL , B.BOOK_ATHR , B.BOOK_CVIM , B.BOOK_ISBN FROM TM_REPORT A LEFT JOIN TM_BKINFO B ON A.BOOK_NUMB = B.BOOK_NUMB WHERE A.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND ( A.REPT_STAT = #{readStat} OR ( A.REPT_STAT = #{doneStat} AND A.REPT_ENDT >= #{currentYearStart} AND A.REPT_ENDT < #{nextYearStart} ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN A.REPT_STAT = #{readStat} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , CASE WHEN A.REPT_STAT = #{readStat} THEN A.REPT_ENDT END ASC , CASE WHEN A.REPT_STAT = #{doneStat} THEN A.REPT_ENDT END DESC , A.REPT_NUMB DESC
mapper.insert: /* setReadingGoal */ MERGE INTO TM_GOALXM G USING ( SELECT #{userNumb} AS USER_NUMB , #{goalDate} AS GOAL_DATE , #{goalType} AS GOAL_TYPE , #{goalCnt} AS GOAL_CNTT FROM DUAL ) S ON ( G.USER_NUMB = S.USER_NUMB AND G.GOAL_DATE = S.GOAL_DATE AND G.GOAL_TYPE = S.GOAL_TYPE ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET G.GOAL_CNTT = S.GOAL_CNTT , G.UPDT_CNTT = CASE WHEN S.GOAL_CNTT < G.GOAL_CNTT THEN NVL(G.UPDT_CNTT, 0) + 1 ELSE NVL(G.UPDT_CNTT, 0) END , G.UPDT_DATE = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( USER_NUMB , GOAL_DATE , GOAL_TYPE , GOAL_CNTT , UPDT_CNTT , REGI_DATE , UPDT_DATE ) VALUES ( S.USER_NUMB , S.GOAL_DATE , S.GOAL_TYPE , S.GOAL_CNTT , 0 , SYSDATE , SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT /* getReportDtl */ A.REPT_NUMB , A.USER_NUMB , A.BOOK_NUMB , A.REPT_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{codeReadStat}, A.REPT_STAT) AS REPT_STAT_NAME , A.REPT_STDT , A.REPT_ENDT , A.REPT_GRDE , A.REPT_COLR , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{codeBookColr}, A.REPT_COLR) AS REPT_COLR_NAME , A.PUBC_YSNO , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{codeCommYsno}, A.PUBC_YSNO, #{optPubcYsno}) AS PUBC_YSNO_NAME , A.REPT_CNTN , NVL(LC.LIKE_CNT, 0) AS LIKE_CNT , NVL(UL.LIKE_YSNO, #{commNo}) AS LIKE_YSNO , NVL(RC.REPL_CNT, 0) AS REPL_CNT , B.BOOK_TITL , B.BOOK_ATHR , B.BOOK_CVIM , B.BOOK_ISBN , B.BOOK_PUBL , B.BOOK_DESC , FN_GET_LOCAL_DATE_STR(B.PUBL_DATE, #{locale}) AS PUBL_DATE , G.BOOK_AVG_GRDE FROM TM_REPORT A LEFT JOIN TM_BKINFO B ON A.BOOK_NUMB = B.BOOK_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT L.TAGT_NUMB AS REPT_NUMB , COUNT(*) AS LIKE_CNT FROM TB_LIKEXX L WHERE L.TAGT_TYPE = #{likeTargetReport} GROUP BY L.TAGT_NUMB ) LC ON A.REPT_NUMB = LC.REPT_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT L.TAGT_NUMB AS REPT_NUMB , #{commYes} AS LIKE_YSNO FROM TB_LIKEXX L WHERE L.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND L.TAGT_TYPE = #{likeTargetReport} ) UL ON A.REPT_NUMB = UL.REPT_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P.BOOK_NUMB , ROUND(AVG(TO_NUMBER(P.REPT_GRDE)), 1) AS BOOK_AVG_GRDE FROM TM_REPORT P WHERE P.REPT_STAT = #{reptStat} GROUP BY P.BOOK_NUMB ) G ON G.BOOK_NUMB = B.BOOK_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT R.REPT_NUMB , COUNT(*) AS REPL_CNT FROM TB_REPLXX R GROUP BY R.REPT_NUMB ) RC ON RC.REPT_NUMB = A.REPT_NUMB WHERE A.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND A.REPT_NUMB = #{reptNumb}

SELECT /* getPublicReportList */ P.REPT_NUMB , P.USER_NUMB , U.USER_NICK , F.FILE_PATH AS PORF_PATH , P.BOOK_NUMB , P.REPT_STAT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{codeReadStat}, P.REPT_STAT) AS REPT_STAT_NAME , P.REPT_GRDE , P.REPT_CNTN , P.PUBC_YSNO , NVL(LC.LIKE_CNT, 0) AS LIKE_CNT , NVL(UL.LIKE_YSNO, #{commNo}) AS LIKE_YSNO , NVL(RPL.REPL_CNT, 0) AS REPL_CNT FROM TM_BKINFO B INNER JOIN TM_REPORT P ON B.BOOK_NUMB = P.BOOK_NUMB INNER JOIN TM_USERXM U ON P.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TM_FILEXM F ON U.PROF_NUMB = F.FILE_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT L.TAGT_NUMB AS REPT_NUMB , COUNT(*) AS LIKE_CNT FROM TB_LIKEXX L WHERE L.TAGT_TYPE = #{likeTargetReport} GROUP BY L.TAGT_NUMB ) LC ON LC.REPT_NUMB = P.REPT_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT L.TAGT_NUMB AS REPT_NUMB , #{commYes} AS LIKE_YSNO FROM TB_LIKEXX L WHERE L.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND L.TAGT_TYPE = #{likeTargetReport} ) UL ON UL.REPT_NUMB = P.REPT_NUMB LEFT JOIN ( SELECT R.REPT_NUMB , COUNT(*) AS REPL_CNT FROM TB_REPLXX R GROUP BY R.REPT_NUMB ) RPL ON RPL.REPT_NUMB = P.REPT_NUMB WHERE P.USER_NUMB != #{userNumb} AND P.PUBC_YSNO = #{commYes} AND B.BOOK_ISBN = #{bookIsbn} ORDER BY P.REPT_NUMB DESC

SELECT /* getPublicRatingAverageByIsbn */ ROUND(AVG(TO_NUMBER(P.REPT_GRDE)), 1) FROM TM_BKINFO B INNER JOIN TM_REPORT P ON B.BOOK_NUMB = P.BOOK_NUMB WHERE B.BOOK_ISBN = #{bookIsbn} AND P.REPT_STAT != #{reptStatRead}
